notes: The GDC official UT402 ring defines the south-west and south-east corners of this 5.7m projection. Its north edge joins the independently authored POB connector.
North-east uses the connector UT437 endpoint, 99.4mm east of the UT402 vertex, to close the registration discrepancy without moving either adjacent building.

Floor2.45 and the sloping metal roof profile exactly match the accepted connector API. The projected neck is visible on the architect ground plan; its partly hidden simple brick returns and stone base are an explicit simplification.

No exterior courtyard floor is removed. The low cut is confined to the closed slab footprint and stops at the shared C-D edge. Roof profile and solid return shapes are inferred, not a recovered scan or interior survey.
No new door or traversable interior is invented. The existing connector's closed entrance, roof, glazing and ownership remain unchanged.
